# conversation-progress

Four-phase progress (research → design → implementation → pushed) per
conversation. `server/` is `portable: true`: the extension table, the live
read, and the `pushLanded` → pushed job, so a browser host serves the row from
its own DB. The git heuristic (`classifyProgressJob`, on
`conversationTurnCompleted`) needs the worktree and lives in `machine/`.

## Plugin reference

- Description: 4-step progress bar (started → designed → implemented → pushed) in the conversation toolbar and sidebar chip. Tracks each conversation through four phases (research → design → implementation → pushed): serves the per-conversation progress row and marks every conversation of an attempt pushed when its work lands. The git heuristic that classifies the first three phases runs in the machine half.
- Web:
  - Contributes:
    - `conversationPane.Actions` "progress" → `ProgressBarToolbar`
    - `Item.Chips` → `ProgressBarRow`
  - Uses:
    - `conversations.useConversationById`
    - `conversations/conversation-ui/item.Item`
    - `conversations/conversation-view.conversationPane`
    - `network/live.LiveRowResult`
    - `network/live.useLiveRow`
    - `primitives/css/inline.Inline`
    - `primitives/live-state.ResourceErrorInline`
    - `ui/segmented-progress-bar.SegmentedProgressBar`
- Server:
  - Contributes:
    - `resource.declare` "conversation-progress:rows"
    - `trigger` "conversation-progress.classify"
    - `trigger` "conversation-progress.mark-pushed"
  - Uses:
    - `database.db`
    - `infra/entity-extensions.defineExtension`
    - `infra/events.Trigger`
    - `infra/jobs.defineJob`
    - `network/live.serveCollection`
    - `tasks/tasks-core._conversations`
    - `tasks/tasks-core.pushLanded`
  - DB schema: `plugins/conversations/plugins/conversation-progress/server/internal/tables.ts`
  - Entity extension of: `tasks/tasks-core` (table `conversations_ext_progress`)
  - Exports (values):

    - `markProgressPushedJob`
  - Register: `defineJob('conversation-progress.mark-pushed')`
  - Resources: `conversation-progress:rows` (keyed, point)
- Core:

  - Exports (values):

- Machine:
